skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the concept and role of project quality management.
Understand the functions of the project management team, the coordination between different departments in project quality management, and build and select appropriate project management models.
Master the process and methods of quality management, project quality management, quality assurance, project quality planning, quality control, and comprehensive project quality management.
Recognize factors affecting project quality management and apply appropriate tools to evaluate project quality management in enterprises and organizations.
Apply knowledge to develop specific project quality management plans.
Analyze and evaluate project quality management issues and find solutions to problems in specific situations.

Develop self-study, independent work, teamwork skills, and accumulate experience to continue higher education to improve professional skills and adapt to globalization and the 4th Industrial Revolution.
Understand laws and comply with all school and class regulations.
